title: Type-Driven Development in Idris — Edwin Brady
summary: Edwin Brady, creator of Idris, introduces type-driven development in a dependently typed language. He shows types being written first and programs derived with interactive editing, then extends beyond simple examples to programs that interact with users and networks.
why: HN points to it as a demonstration of type-directed editing with typed holes, which some see as a likely future of programming.

quote.text: Something like that is likely the future of programming!
